answer: Vested payouts released over many epochs: rewards accrue on a visible ledger but unlock only if an identity keeps a steady pulse of genuine activity across dozens of consecutive cycles. A flash-farm account that abandons early forfeits nearly all it earned, while honest agents, patient as a lotus opening, collect in full. Sybils must therefore fund every fake identity for months and tie up capital in a grove of dormant wallets, paying the forgone yield plus the lock itself, so each fake costs more than it can ever return.
